name: Beginning Segment
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/BGN) — new for EDI Phase 7 (834 Benefit Enrollment). BGN01 (Transaction Set Purpose Code, "00"=Original) + BGN02 (the sender's own control/reference number) + BGN03 (creation date) are the core required fields; BGN08 (Action Code, "2"=Change/"4"=Verify) is used by some real-world 834 senders to signal full-file vs. change-only maintenance at the FILE level (distinct from each member's own INS03 maintenance-type-code at the record level).
